core_business: SP1 is a high-performance zero-knowledge virtual machine (zkVM) that proves correct execution of arbitrary RISC-V programs. It generates succinct proofs (STARK, Groth16, PLONK) that can be verified on-chain. Used for blockchain rollups, verifiable computation, and privacy-preserving applications. Supports CPU, GPU, and remote network proving backends.

core_modules.description: User-facing SDK with Prover trait and five backend variants (CPU, CUDA, Network, Mock, Light)
Proving pipeline orchestration: task management, recursion program building, compress/shrink/wrap

sub_modules.function: Recursion program builders (normalize, compose, shrink, wrap)

core_modules.description: Per-shard STARK proving: AIR, LogUp-GKR, zerocheck, PCS, SepticDigest global accumulation

sub_modules.function: Shard proof generation (trace, commit, sumcheck, eval proof)

core_modules.description: Cycle-accurate RISC-V VM execution with precompile support and trace generation

sub_modules.function: RISC-V virtual machine (ALU, branch, jump, syscall)
Optimized executor with architecture-specific paths (x86_64, portable)

core_modules.description: AIR constraint columns and RISC-V chip definitions with TrustMode dispatch
Recursive proof composition: circuit DSL, compiler, executor, machine, Gnark FFI

sub_modules.function: Recursion circuit definitions and recursive verifiers
Gnark bridge for Groth16/PLONK BN254 wrapping

core_modules.description: no_std Groth16 and PLONK proof verification with embedded vkeys
Core type aliases (SP1Field, SP1ExtensionField), Poseidon2 hash, IopCtx contexts

GPU-accelerated implementations of proving components (CUDA kernels)

summary: SP1: Rust zkVM proving RISC-V execution via STARKs (Hypercube), recursive composition, Groth16/PLONK wrapping. KoalaBear field, Plonky3 fork, CPU/GPU/Network backends.
